title: The Railway on the Roof of the World
subtitle: 考点：工程创造 / result in, be responsible for, speed up
passage: The Qinghai-Tibet Railway goes to Lhasa and passes through Tanggula Pass, which is more than five thousand metres above sea level. Building it was a huge challenge. In many places, the ground is frozen soil. In summer, the top layer can melt, and a railway on soft ground may sink.

Engineers had good ideas. They put special pipes into the ground to keep the soil cold. They also built long bridges, so the railway does not touch the ground in some places. Thousands of workers were responsible for the building work, and new machines helped to speed it up. The railway has led to a rapid growth in tourism, and it makes life easier for people in Tibet.
